bathtub.songTitle: That’s the Way That the World Goes ’Round
bathtub.linePrev: That's the way that the world goes 'round
bathtub.line: I was sitting in the bathtub counting my toes
bathtub.lineNext: When the radiator broke, water all froze
stanza: I was sitting in the bathtub counting my toes
When the radiator broke, water all froze
I got stuck in the ice without my clothes
Naked as the eyes of a clown

bathtub.linePrev: Spent your whole life sweating in an endless fever
bathtub.line: And now you're laying in a bathtub full of freezing water
stanza: Saying everything you've ever seen was just a mirror
Spent your whole life sweating in an endless fever
And now you're laying in a bathtub full of freezing water
But once you knew a girl and you named her Lover
Danced with her in kitchens through the greenest summer
You can't remember where she said she was going to
